100 Tiny Decisions You Don't Need to Overthink (Just Pick and Move On)

Stop overthinking the small stuff. 100 tiny decisions you do not need to agonize over — flip a coin and move on.

May 18, 2026Magic Decisions6 min read

most of the decisions that drain your mental energy don't matter. Flip a coin. Spin a wheel. Move on with your day.

You spent 15 minutes choosing a restaurant last week. Or agonizing over which streaming service show to start. Perhaps you're experiencing decision paralysis. Or debating whether to use the self-checkout or the regular checkout. None of that time was worth it. The decision didn't change your life. It stole your attention.

some decisions are tiny. They deserve seconds of thought, not minutes. They deserve a coin flip, not a committee meeting. And when you learn to recognize these tiny decisions and let them go, your brain gets freed up for the things that matter.

Save this list. Refer to it when you feel yourself spiraling. Use our spin wheel or coin flip to make these. Then use your saved brain power for something important.

🍽️ Food & Drink Decisions

1. What to eat for a random Tuesday dinner

2. Coffee or tea (you can switch tomorrow)

3. Which restaurant to order from

4. What flavor of yogurt to buy

5. White milk or chocolate milk

6. Should you have the bread basket

7. Pizza topping 1 vs pizza topping 2

8. Drink water or sparkling water

9. Pack lunch or buy lunch today

10. Which chips to get at the store

👕 Clothing & Appearance

11. Which color t-shirt to wear

12. Jeans or joggers for a casual day

13. Wear a watch or leave it at home

14. Flip-flops or sneakers (in summer)

15. Wear a necklace or not today

16. Hair down or in a ponytail

17. Which pair of socks (they're all fine)

18. Wear the new shirt or save it

19. Belt or no belt (most days)

20. Earrings or no earrings

🏠 Home & Household

21. Where to put that decorative item

22. Which towel to use (you have several)

23. Clean the kitchen now or later

24. Which grocery store to shop at

25. Hand wash that dish or run the dishwasher

26. Rearrange the living room (for the 5th time)

27. Open the window or use AC

28. Buy the generic or name brand

29. Put laundry away now or tomorrow

30. Which sponge to use

📱 Entertainment & Screen Time

31. Which TV show to start watching

32. Listen to music or a podcast right now

33. Scroll Instagram or read an article

34. Watch a movie or a series episode

35. Which YouTube video to watch next

36. Play a game or watch something

37. Continue reading that book or start a new one

38. Disney+ or Netflix (they both have good stuff)

39. Listen to a new album or an old favorite

40. Watch alone or invite someone

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family & Kids Decisions

41. Which park to visit

42. Bedtime at 8:00 or 8:15

43. What to make for kids' snacks

44. Order pizza or make pasta

45. Go to the pool or the playground

46. Screen time now or after homework

47. What movie for family movie night

48. One more book or lights out

49. Let them wear the mismatched outfit (they'll survive)

50. Who picks the music in the car

💼 Work & Productivity

51. Check email now or in 30 minutes

52. Write that email now or tomorrow morning

53. Work from coffee shop or home

54. Listen to music or silence while working

55. Desktop or laptop for this task

56. Agenda first or jump right into tasks

57. Reply now or schedule for later

58. Take the stairs or elevator

59. Eat at desk or take a lunch break

60. Handle this task now or batch it

🛒 Shopping & Spending

61. Self-checkout or regular checkout

62. Buy it now or put it back and think for a week

63. Standard shipping or pay for faster

64. Order online or go to the store

65. Wrap the gift or use a gift bag

66. Pay with card or cash

67. Amazon or another retailer

68. Use a coupon or not (if small savings)

69. Save the receipt or toss it

70. Buy the storage solution or just organize better

🗓️ Scheduling & Planning

71. Morning workout or evening workout

72. Call mom Tuesday or Wednesday

73. Schedule that appointment now or set a reminder

74. Do chores before fun or fun before chores

75. Start that project today or Monday

76. Social event or quiet night at home

77. Do it now while you think of it or add to to-do list

78. Morning routine order (shower before breakfast or vice versa)

79. Book the flight now or keep watching prices

80. Leave at 8:00 or 8:15 to arrive on time

🧘 Mindset & Energy Management

81. Meditation or just breathing deeply

82. Take a walk or do stretches at your desk

83. Say yes or no to that invitation

84. Respond calmly or wait until you're not frustrated

85. Address that conflict or let it go

86. Hold that grudge or let it go

87. Focus on the problem or the solution

88. Say something or stay quiet

89. Ask for help or try solo first

90. Finish that book or DNF it (do not finish)

🤷 Random Everyday Moments

91. Turn left or turn right (when exploring)

92. Text back now or respond later

93. Use the pen or pencil (for non-critical notes)

94. Stand up or stay seated (for short movements)

95. Open the blinds or keep them closed

96. Start the laundry now or after dinner

97. Clean now or set a timer for tomorrow

98. Flip a coin for anything with two options

99. Use a decision wheel when three or more options

100. Spend 10 seconds deciding or 10 minutes—your call

The Takeaway

This list isn't about being reckless. It's about recognizing that your attention is finite. all minute you spend debating cereal brands is a minute not spent on things that matter to you and your .

> "The goal isn't to stop making decisions. The goal is to stop making some decisions mean more than they do."

Next time you catch yourself spiraling over something small, come back to this list. Ask: is this a decision I should invest brain power in, or a decision I should make in seconds and move on? These tiny choices matter less than you think.

And when you need help making those tiny decisions? Spin the wheel. Flip the coin. Let randomness be your guide and your brain will thank you.
